REFLOW.TITLE: Carbon footprint calculator
REFLOW.DESCRIPTION:
Scope 3 emissions can account for up to 80% of a company's total carbon footprint. Measuring and reducing this footprint is a crucial step in any emission reduction pathway. Understanding your product's climate footprint is a vital first step toward reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in the production process. This method offers a focused, scientific estimation of emissions from raw material extraction through to the point your product leaves your facility.

QIMA and ReFlow have joined forces to offer you tools for measuring the product carbon footprint. These tools enable you to identify products with the highest embedded emissions, make informed design and sourcing decisions, or calculate a full Product Carbon LCA (Life Cycle Assessment) for external communication.

Take your first steps now with Product Estimate Calculations.
REFLOW.CALCULATOR_DESCRIPTION: This quick and easy calculation is designed to use just a few basic data points to deliver an estimation of your product carbon footprint.</br></br>By calculating an estimate of a wide range of products, you will get an overview of which products potentially have the highest embedded emissions.
REFLOW.WORKFLOW_DESCRIPTION: Simply click on calculate product carbon footprint.</br></br>In here, you can add products for which you'd like to receive calculations. For each product, we need you to provide the product type and quantity. </br></br>Each product calculation will cost only $20. The estimate calculation is delivered after we receive the payment.
REFLOW.PROCESS_DESCRIPTION:
The calculated estimate should strictly be used to internally prioritize which products and supply chains require a more thorough calculation. This calculation is not suitable for use as a product claim.

Should you require more specific calculations, please consider our Cradle-to-Grave or full Life Cycle services. Please click here to find out how QIMA and ReFlow can assist you in gathering the necessary data from your supply chain for these calculations.
REFLOW.QUANTITY_TOOLTIP: Identify the quantity of measure climate in which the item is calculated.
REFLOW.PAY_TIP: Upon completing the payment, you will receive an email that provides a comprehensive breakdown of the estimated carbon footprint results for your products.
